cod.title: COD collection needs reconciliation
cod.body: The delivery record does not show how much cash the courier collected or what remains due. This alert does not confirm that the order total was collected or that COD is settled.
cod.nextStep: Compare the courier booking/remittance with the buyer's receipt and verify any remaining due manually. This screen cannot resolve the reconciliation flag or confirm settlement.

verifiedPayment.title: Verified payment needs courier reconciliation
verifiedPayment.body: The gateway payment was verified, but the courier collection record has not been reconciled against it. The amount collected by the courier is not established here.
verifiedPayment.nextStep: Compare the gateway transaction with the courier booking/remittance and buyer receipt. This screen cannot determine the collected amount or resolve the reconciliation flag.

terminalOrder.title: Payment and order state need review
terminalOrder.body: Gateway payment verification was recorded after this order had already reached a terminal state. That verification alone does not show whether courier collection changed or settlement is complete.
terminalOrder.nextStep: Compare the source payment, order, and courier records with the buyer's receipt before taking action. This screen cannot resolve the flag.

unknown.title: Payment and courier records need review
unknown.body: A reconciliation flag is stored for this order, but its code does not provide enough information to determine payment settlement or courier collection.
unknown.nextStep: Compare the original payment and order records with the courier booking/remittance and buyer receipt. This screen cannot clear the flag or record settlement.
